# OmniaUI — full reference for AI assistants

> OmniaUI is the component and block library for OmniaCSS: 145 components and
> 85 page blocks (dashboards, auth, pricing, marketing …) as plain HTML with oc-* classes, plus
> wrappers for React, Vue, Laravel Blade and Livewire. Behaviour comes from native HTML (dialog, popover, details,
> :has(), anchor positioning), so most components need no JavaScript. Free and MIT licensed; 39 advanced
> blocks are part of OmniaUI Pro (paid license).

## Rules for AI assistants

- Use the reference markup of a component instead of writing one from scratch: the classes, ARIA attributes and
  structure matter (a modal is <dialog class="oc-modal"> opened with command="show-modal" commandfor="id").
- OmniaUI classes start with oc- (oc-btn, oc-card, oc-modal). Layout and spacing around them use OmniaCSS utilities,
  which are NOT Tailwind: read https://omniacss.eu/llms.txt.
- Colors come from theme tokens (--oc-primary, --oc-background, --oc-foreground, --oc-border …) that switch with light
  and dark mode via light-dark(). Do not hard-code colors on components.
- Blocks marked (Pro) need an OmniaUI Pro license; their markup is not public. Suggest a free block or component instead
  unless the project has @birdycom/omniaui-pro installed.
- The MCP server gives the exact markup of every component and block: claude mcp add omniacss -- npx -y @birdycom/omniacss-mcp

## Install

npm (with OmniaCSS):
  npm install @birdycom/omniacss @birdycom/omniaui @birdycom/omniaui-blocks
  /* CSS entry */ @import "@birdycom/omniaui"; @import "@birdycom/omniaui-blocks";
Add one component or block to the project as HTML, React, Vue or Blade:
  npx omniaui add modal
  npx omniaui add pricing --framework react
React: npm install @birdycom/omniaui-react   (import { Button, Modal } from "@birdycom/omniaui-react")
Vue:   npm install @birdycom/omniaui-vue     (import { OcButton, OcModal } from "@birdycom/omniaui-vue")
Laravel:
  composer require birdycom/omniaui-laravel && php artisan omniacss:install
  <x-oc::button variant="primary">Save</x-oc::button>   <x-oc::block.app-shell>…</x-oc::block.app-shell>
Livewire: composer require birdycom/omniaui-livewire

## Component reference markup

Copy these as they are and change the content. Docs page per component: https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/<name>.

### button

Buttons: default, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive and sizes

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: button — Buttons: default, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive and sizes. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS. -->
<button class="oc-btn">Default</button>
<button class="oc-btn oc-btn--secondary">Secondary</button>
<button class="oc-btn oc-btn--outline">Outline</button>
<button class="oc-btn oc-btn--ghost">Ghost</button>
<button class="oc-btn oc-btn--destructive">Delete</button>
<button class="oc-btn oc-btn--sm">Small</button>
<button class="oc-btn oc-btn--lg">Large</button>
```

### card

Card with header, content, footer

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: card — Card with header, content, footer. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS. -->
<div class="oc-card">
  <div class="oc-card-header">
    <h3 class="oc-card-title">Create project</h3>
    <p class="oc-card-description">Deploy your new project in one click.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="oc-card-content">
    <div class="oc-field">
      <label class="oc-field-label" for="project-name">Name</label>
      <input class="oc-input" id="project-name" placeholder="My project">
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="oc-card-footer">
    <button class="oc-btn oc-btn--outline">Cancel</button>
    <button class="oc-btn">Deploy</button>
  </div>
</div>
```

### badge

Badges

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: badge — Badges. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS. -->
<span class="oc-badge">Badge</span>
<span class="oc-badge oc-badge--secondary">Secondary</span>
<span class="oc-badge oc-badge--outline">Outline</span>
<span class="oc-badge oc-badge--destructive">Error</span>
```

### alert

Alerts: info, success, warning, danger

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: alert — Alerts: info, success, warning, danger. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS. -->
<div class="oc-alert oc-alert--info" role="status">
  <h4 class="oc-alert-title">Heads up!</h4>
  <p class="oc-alert-description">You can add components with the OmniaCSS CLI.</p>
</div>
```

### modal

Modal on <dialog> — opens with invoker commands, no JavaScript

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: modal — Modal on <dialog> — opens with invoker commands, no JavaScript. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS. -->
<button class="oc-btn" command="show-modal" commandfor="oc-modal-demo">Open modal</button>

<dialog class="oc-modal" id="oc-modal-demo" closedby="any" aria-labelledby="oc-modal-demo-title">
  <div class="oc-modal-content">
    <div class="oc-modal-header">
      <h2 class="oc-modal-title" id="oc-modal-demo-title">Are you sure?</h2>
      <p class="oc-modal-description">This action cannot be undone.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="oc-modal-footer">
      <button class="oc-btn oc-btn--outline" command="close" commandfor="oc-modal-demo">Cancel</button>
      <button class="oc-btn oc-btn--destructive" command="close" commandfor="oc-modal-demo">Delete</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

### dropdown

Dropdown menu on popover + anchor positioning — no JavaScript

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: dropdown — Dropdown menu on popover + anchor positioning — no JavaScript. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS. -->
<button class="oc-btn oc-btn--outline" popovertarget="oc-menu-demo">Options</button>
<div class="oc-dropdown-menu" id="oc-menu-demo" popover>
  <div class="oc-dropdown-label">My account</div>
  <a class="oc-dropdown-item" href="#profile">Profile</a>
  <a class="oc-dropdown-item" href="#settings">Settings</a>
  <div class="oc-dropdown-separator"></div>
  <a class="oc-dropdown-item" href="#logout">Log out</a>
</div>
```

### accordion

Exclusive accordion on <details name> — no JavaScript

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: accordion — Exclusive accordion on <details name> — no JavaScript. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS. -->
<div class="oc-accordion">
  <details class="oc-accordion-item" name="faq" open>
    <summary class="oc-accordion-trigger">Is it accessible?</summary>
    <div class="oc-accordion-content">Yes. It uses the native details/summary elements.</div>
  </details>
  <details class="oc-accordion-item" name="faq">
    <summary class="oc-accordion-trigger">Does it need JavaScript?</summary>
    <div class="oc-accordion-content">No. Items with the same name open one at a time.</div>
  </details>
</div>
```

### tabs

Tabs with radio inputs and :has() — no JavaScript

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: tabs — Tabs with radio inputs and :has() — no JavaScript. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS. -->
<div class="oc-tabset">
  <div class="oc-tab-list" role="tablist">
    <label class="oc-tab-trigger"><input type="radio" name="oc-tabs-demo" checked> Account</label>
    <label class="oc-tab-trigger"><input type="radio" name="oc-tabs-demo"> Password</label>
  </div>
  <div class="oc-tab-panel">Make changes to your account here.</div>
  <div class="oc-tab-panel">Change your password here.</div>
</div>
```

### theme-switch

System / light / dark switch — CSS only (color-scheme + :has())

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: theme-switch — System / light / dark switch — CSS only (color-scheme + :has()). Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS. -->
<fieldset class="oc-theme-switch" aria-label="Color theme">
  <label><input type="radio" name="oc-theme" value="system" checked> System</label>
  <label><input type="radio" name="oc-theme" value="light"> Light</label>
  <label><input type="radio" name="oc-theme" value="dark"> Dark</label>
</fieldset>
```

### counter

Animated number (@property) — starts when scrolled into view

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: counter — Animated number (@property) — starts when scrolled into view. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS. -->
<strong class="oc-counter oc-counter--on-view" style="--oc-counter-to: 1250; --oc-counter-suffix: '+'"></strong>
```

### tooltip

Tooltip (CSS only)

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: tooltip — Tooltip (CSS only). Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS. -->
<span class="oc-tooltip" data-tooltip="Saved to your library">
  <button class="oc-btn oc-btn--outline">Hover me</button>
</span>
```

```html
  <span class="oc-avatar">SC</span>
  <span class="oc-avatar">BC</span>
  <span class="oc-avatar oc-avatar--lg">OM</span>
</div>
```

### progress

Progress bar

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: progress — Progress bar. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS. -->
<div class="oc-progress" role="progressbar" aria-valuenow="60" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100">
  <div class="oc-progress-bar" style="width: 60%"></div>
</div>
```

### breadcrumb

Breadcrumb

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: breadcrumb — Breadcrumb. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS. -->
<nav class="oc-breadcrumb" aria-label="Breadcrumb">
  <a class="oc-breadcrumb-item" href="/">Home</a>
  <a class="oc-breadcrumb-item" href="/docs/">Docs</a>
  <span class="oc-breadcrumb-item" aria-current="page">Components</span>
</nav>
```

### pagination

Pagination

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: pagination — Pagination. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS. -->
<nav class="oc-pagination" aria-label="Pagination">
  <a class="oc-pagination-item" href="?page=1">1</a>
  <a class="oc-pagination-item" href="?page=2" aria-current="page">2</a>
  <a class="oc-pagination-item" href="?page=3">3</a>
</nav>
```

```html
<div class="oc-skeleton oc-skeleton--circle"></div>
<div class="oc-skeleton oc-skeleton--title"></div>
<div class="oc-skeleton oc-skeleton--text"></div>
```

### form-field

Form field with label, description and error

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: form-field — Form field with label, description and error. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS. -->
<div class="oc-field">
  <label class="oc-field-label" for="email">Email</label>
  <input class="oc-input" id="email" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" aria-describedby="email-help">
  <p class="oc-field-description" id="email-help">We never share your email.</p>
</div>
```

### heading

Page or section title with a muted description

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: heading - Page or section title with a muted description. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     Class API (modifiers are extra classes / attributes on the same element):
       .oc-heading: Wrapper (title + description). Modifier: --sm for a section heading.
       .oc-heading-title: Title (use h1-h3 as fits the outline)
       .oc-heading-description: Muted description (optional)
-->
<div class="oc-heading">
  <h2 class="oc-heading-title">Profile</h2>
  <p class="oc-heading-description">Update your name and e-mail address.</p>
</div>
<div class="oc-heading oc-heading--sm">
  <h3 class="oc-heading-title">Password</h3>
  <p class="oc-heading-description">Use a long, random password.</p>
</div>
```

### back-link

Outline link that names its destination (Back to Products)

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: back-link - Outline link that names its destination (Back to Products). Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     Class API (modifiers are extra classes / attributes on the same element):
       .oc-back-link: Anchor styled as an outline button with a leading arrow
-->
<a class="oc-back-link" href="#">Back to Products</a>
```

### user

Avatar with name and e-mail, truncating

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: user - Avatar with name and e-mail, truncating. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     Class API (modifiers are extra classes / attributes on the same element):
       .oc-user: Flex row wrapper
       .oc-avatar: Avatar from the avatar component (initials or img)
       .oc-user-text: Text column
       .oc-user-name: Name (truncates)
       .oc-user-email: Secondary line (truncates)
-->
<div class="oc-user">
  <span class="oc-avatar">SC</span>
  <span class="oc-user-text">
    <span class="oc-user-name">Serge Cools</span>
    <span class="oc-user-email">serge@example.com</span>
  </span>
</div>
```

### empty-state

Icon, title, text and actions for lists without data

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: empty-state - Icon, title, text and actions for lists without data. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     Class API (modifiers are extra classes / attributes on the same element):
       .oc-empty: Centered column wrapper
       .oc-empty-icon: Round icon holder (glyph, emoji or inline SVG)
       .oc-empty-title: Heading
       .oc-empty-text: Explanation
       .oc-empty-actions: Row for buttons (optional)
-->
<div class="oc-empty">
  <span class="oc-empty-icon" aria-hidden="true">+</span>
  <h3 class="oc-empty-title">No contacts yet</h3>
  <p class="oc-empty-text">Add your first contact to start tracking conversations and invoices.</p>
  <div class="oc-empty-actions">
    <button class="oc-btn" type="button">New contact</button>
    <button class="oc-btn oc-btn--outline" type="button">Import</button>
  </div>
</div>
```

### sidebar

Vertical navigation: header, groups, menu items, badges, nested menu, footer, icon-only mode

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: sidebar - Vertical navigation: header, groups, menu items, badges, nested menu, footer, icon-only mode. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     Class API (modifiers are extra classes / attributes on the same element):
       .oc-sidebar: Root (aside/nav). Modifiers: --collapsed (icon only), --right, --floating. Width via --oc-sidebar-width / --oc-sidebar-width-icon.
       .oc-sidebar-header / -footer: Fixed top / bottom area (logo, workspace switcher / user)
       .oc-sidebar-content: Scrolling middle area
       .oc-sidebar-group: Group of items; optional .oc-sidebar-group-label heading
       .oc-sidebar-separator: Divider line
       .oc-sidebar-menu: ul of items
       .oc-sidebar-menu-button: Link or button of an item. State: aria-current="page" or .is-active; aria-disabled="true". Modifier: --lg.
       .oc-sidebar-menu-icon: 16px icon (inline SVG)
       .oc-sidebar-menu-label: Label (hidden when collapsed)
       .oc-sidebar-menu-badge: Count pill on the right
       .oc-sidebar-menu-sub: Nested ul with a guide line
       details.oc-sidebar-collapsible: Expandable item: <summary class="oc-sidebar-menu-button"> + .oc-sidebar-menu-sub
     Slots: header, group label, menu items (default), nested items (.oc-sidebar-menu-sub), footer
-->
<aside class="oc-sidebar " aria-label="Main navigation">
  <div class="oc-sidebar-header">
    <a class="oc-sidebar-menu-button oc-sidebar-menu-button--lg" href="#">
      <svg class="oc-sidebar-menu-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 11l9-8 9 8v10a1 1 0 0 1-1 1h-5v-6H9v6H4a1 1 0 0 1-1-1z"/></svg>
      <span class="oc-sidebar-menu-label"><strong>OmniaDesk</strong></span>
    </a>
  </div>
  <div class="oc-sidebar-content">
    <div class="oc-sidebar-group">
      <div class="oc-sidebar-group-label">Platform</div>
      <ul class="oc-sidebar-menu">
        <li><a class="oc-sidebar-menu-button" href="#" aria-current="page"><svg class="oc-sidebar-menu-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 11l9-8 9 8v10a1 1 0 0 1-1 1h-5v-6H9v6H4a1 1 0 0 1-1-1z"/></svg><span class="oc-sidebar-menu-label">Dashboard</span></a></li>
        <li><a class="oc-sidebar-menu-button" href="#"><svg class="oc-sidebar-menu-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="9" cy="8" r="4"/><path d="M2 21c0-4 3-6 7-6s7 2 7 6"/></svg><span class="oc-sidebar-menu-label">Contacts</span><span class="oc-sidebar-menu-badge">12</span></a></li>
        <li>
          <details class="oc-sidebar-collapsible" open>
            <summary class="oc-sidebar-menu-button"><svg class="oc-sidebar-menu-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 2h8l5 5v15H6z"/><path d="M14 2v5h5"/></svg><span class="oc-sidebar-menu-label">Invoices</span></summary>
            <ul class="oc-sidebar-menu-sub">
              <li><a class="oc-sidebar-menu-button" href="#">Sales</a></li>
              <li><a class="oc-sidebar-menu-button" href="#">Purchases</a></li>
            </ul>
          </details>
        </li>
        <li><a class="oc-sidebar-menu-button" href="#"><svg class="oc-sidebar-menu-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 20V10M10 20V4M16 20v-8M22 20H2"/></svg><span class="oc-sidebar-menu-label">Reports</span></a></li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    <div class="oc-sidebar-separator"></div>
    <div class="oc-sidebar-group">
      <ul class="oc-sidebar-menu">
        <li><a class="oc-sidebar-menu-button" href="#"><svg class="oc-sidebar-menu-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M12 2v3M12 19v3M2 12h3M19 12h3M5 5l2 2M17 17l2 2M19 5l-2 2M7 17l-2 2"/></svg><span class="oc-sidebar-menu-label">Settings</span></a></li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="oc-sidebar-footer">
    <div class="oc-user">
      <span class="oc-avatar oc-avatar--sm">SC</span>
      <span class="oc-user-text"><span class="oc-user-name">Serge Cools</span><span class="oc-user-email">serge@example.com</span></span>
    </div>
  </div>
</aside>
```

### navmenu

Horizontal navigation links with optional dropdown children

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: navmenu - Horizontal navigation links with optional dropdown children. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     Class API (modifiers are extra classes / attributes on the same element):
       .oc-navmenu: ul row of items
       .oc-navmenu-link: Link or button. State: aria-current="page" or .is-active
       .oc-navmenu-link--caret: Adds a chevron (trigger of a dropdown)
       .oc-dropdown-menu[popover]: Child menu, from the dropdown component
-->
<nav aria-label="Module navigation">
  <ul class="oc-navmenu">
    <li><a class="oc-navmenu-link" href="#" aria-current="page">Overview</a></li>
    <li><a class="oc-navmenu-link" href="#">Contacts</a></li>
    <li>
      <button class="oc-navmenu-link oc-navmenu-link--caret" type="button" popovertarget="oc-navmenu-sales">Sales</button>
      <div class="oc-dropdown-menu" id="oc-navmenu-sales" popover>
        <div class="oc-dropdown-label">Documents</div>
        <a class="oc-dropdown-item" href="#">Quotes</a>
        <a class="oc-dropdown-item" href="#">Orders</a>
        <a class="oc-dropdown-item" href="#">Invoices</a>
      </div>
    </li>
    <li><a class="oc-navmenu-link" href="#">Reports</a></li>
  </ul>
</nav>
```

### sheet

Side panel on <dialog> (right, left, top, bottom) - no JavaScript

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: sheet - Side panel on <dialog> (right, left, top, bottom) - no JavaScript. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     Class API (modifiers are extra classes / attributes on the same element):
       dialog.oc-sheet: The dialog. Side modifiers: --left, --top, --bottom (default right).
       .oc-sheet-content: Panel. Modifier: --wide.
       .oc-sheet-header / -title / -description: Heading area
       .oc-sheet-body: Scrolling content
       .oc-sheet-footer: Action row
       .oc-sheet-close: Close button (command="close")
     Slots: header (title, description), body (default), footer, trigger button outside the dialog
-->
<button class="oc-btn oc-btn--outline" type="button" command="show-modal" commandfor="oc-sheet-demo">Open sheet</button>

<dialog class="oc-sheet" id="oc-sheet-demo" closedby="any" aria-labelledby="oc-sheet-demo-title">
  <div class="oc-sheet-content">
    <button class="oc-sheet-close" type="button" command="close" commandfor="oc-sheet-demo" aria-label="Close">&times;</button>
    <div class="oc-sheet-header">
      <h2 class="oc-sheet-title" id="oc-sheet-demo-title">Table design</h2>
      <p class="oc-sheet-description">Choose the columns you want to see.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="oc-sheet-body">
      <div class="oc-field-group">
        <label><input class="oc-checkbox" type="checkbox" checked> Name</label>
        <label><input class="oc-checkbox" type="checkbox" checked> E-mail</label>
        <label><input class="oc-checkbox" type="checkbox"> Phone</label>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="oc-sheet-footer">
      <button class="oc-btn oc-btn--outline" type="button" command="close" commandfor="oc-sheet-demo">Cancel</button>
      <button class="oc-btn" type="button" command="close" commandfor="oc-sheet-demo">Save</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

### alert-dialog

Confirmation modal with a status icon (success, error, warning, info, question)

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: alert-dialog - Confirmation modal with a status icon (success, error, warning, info, question). Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     Class API (modifiers are extra classes / attributes on the same element):
       dialog.oc-modal: Native dialog from the modal component
       .oc-modal-content.oc-modal-content--sm.oc-alert-dialog: Centered content box
       .oc-alert-dialog--success / --error / --warning / --info / --question: Type modifier on the content element (sets the icon color)
       .oc-alert-dialog-icon: Round icon holder with a glyph (!, &#10003;, ?, i, &times;)
       .oc-modal-title / -body / -footer: Title, message and the buttons (secondary left, primary right)
     Slots: icon, title, message (body), footer buttons (secondary + primary)
-->
<button class="oc-btn oc-btn--destructive" type="button" command="show-modal" commandfor="oc-alert-dialog-demo">Delete contact</button>

<dialog class="oc-modal" id="oc-alert-dialog-demo" closedby="closerequest" aria-labelledby="oc-alert-dialog-title" aria-describedby="oc-alert-dialog-text">
  <div class="oc-modal-content oc-modal-content--sm oc-alert-dialog oc-alert-dialog--warning">
    <span class="oc-alert-dialog-icon" aria-hidden="true">!</span>
    <h2 class="oc-modal-title" id="oc-alert-dialog-title">Delete this contact?</h2>
    <div class="oc-modal-body" id="oc-alert-dialog-text">All related documents stay, but the link to this contact is removed.</div>
    <div class="oc-modal-footer">
      <button class="oc-btn oc-btn--outline" type="button" command="close" commandfor="oc-alert-dialog-demo">Cancel</button>
      <button class="oc-btn oc-btn--destructive" type="button" command="close" commandfor="oc-alert-dialog-demo">Delete</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

### popover

Floating panel on popover + anchor positioning - no JavaScript

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: popover - Floating panel on popover + anchor positioning - no JavaScript. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     Class API (modifiers are extra classes / attributes on the same element):
       .oc-popover[popover]: The panel. Sizes: --sm, --lg.
       .oc-popover-title / -text: Optional heading and body text
       button[popovertarget]: Trigger
-->
<button class="oc-btn oc-btn--outline" type="button" popovertarget="oc-popover-demo">Dimensions</button>
<div class="oc-popover" id="oc-popover-demo" popover>
  <h3 class="oc-popover-title">Dimensions</h3>
  <p class="oc-popover-text">Set the width and height of the layer.</p>
  <div class="oc-field" style="margin-top:.75rem">
    <label class="oc-field-label" for="oc-popover-width">Width</label>
    <input class="oc-input" id="oc-popover-width" value="100%">
  </div>
</div>
```

### command

Command palette / searchable list styling (filter logic in a wrapper)

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: command - Command palette / searchable list styling (filter logic in a wrapper). Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     Class API (modifiers are extra classes / attributes on the same element):
       .oc-command: Root
       .oc-command-input: Search input
       .oc-command-list: Results ul
       .oc-command-group-label: Group heading
       .oc-command-item: Result. State: aria-selected="true", aria-disabled="true", hidden
       .oc-command-shortcut: Keyboard hint on the right
       .oc-command-separator: Divider
       .oc-command-empty: Shown when nothing matches
-->
<div class="oc-command" role="combobox" aria-expanded="true" aria-haspopup="listbox">
  <input class="oc-command-input" type="search" placeholder="Type a command or search..." aria-label="Search commands">
  <ul class="oc-command-list" role="listbox">
    <li class="oc-command-group-label" role="presentation">Suggestions</li>
    <li class="oc-command-item" role="option" aria-selected="true">New invoice <span class="oc-command-shortcut">Ctrl N</span></li>
    <li class="oc-command-item" role="option">Open contacts</li>
    <li class="oc-command-separator" role="separator"></li>
    <li class="oc-command-group-label" role="presentation">Settings</li>
    <li class="oc-command-item" role="option">Appearance</li>
    <li class="oc-command-item" role="option" aria-disabled="true">Billing</li>
  </ul>
  <div class="oc-command-empty" hidden>No results found.</div>
</div>
```

### toast

Transient notifications (success, error, warning, info) with optional CSS auto-dismiss

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: toast - Transient notifications (success, error, warning, info) with optional CSS auto-dismiss. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     Class API (modifiers are extra classes / attributes on the same element):
       .oc-toast-container: Fixed stack (bottom right). Modifiers: --top, --static (in-flow, for docs).
       .oc-toast: One notification (role="status"; use role="alert" for errors). Variants: --success, --error, --warning, --info. --auto = CSS auto-dismiss.
       .oc-toast-icon: Status glyph
       .oc-toast-body: Text column
       .oc-toast-title / -description: Heading and optional text
       .oc-toast-close: Dismiss button
     Slots: icon, title, description, close
-->
<div class="oc-toast-container oc-toast-container--static">
  <div class="oc-toast oc-toast--success" role="status">
    <span class="oc-toast-icon" aria-hidden="true">&#10003;</span>
    <div class="oc-toast-body">
      <p class="oc-toast-title">Contact saved</p>
      <p class="oc-toast-description">Your changes are stored.</p>
    </div>
    <button class="oc-toast-close" type="button" aria-label="Dismiss">&times;</button>
  </div>
  <div class="oc-toast oc-toast--error" role="alert">
    <span class="oc-toast-icon" aria-hidden="true">!</span>
    <div class="oc-toast-body">
      <p class="oc-toast-title">Could not send invoice</p>
      <p class="oc-toast-description">The e-mail address is invalid.</p>
    </div>
    <button class="oc-toast-close" type="button" aria-label="Dismiss">&times;</button>
  </div>
  <div class="oc-toast oc-toast--warning" role="status">
    <span class="oc-toast-icon" aria-hidden="true">!</span>
    <div class="oc-toast-body"><p class="oc-toast-title">License expires in 3 days</p></div>
  </div>
  <div class="oc-toast oc-toast--info" role="status">
    <span class="oc-toast-icon" aria-hidden="true">i</span>
    <div class="oc-toast-body"><p class="oc-toast-title">A new version is available</p></div>
  </div>
</div>
```

### tag-input

Chips with remove buttons and a free-text input with suggestions

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: tag-input - Chips with remove buttons and a free-text input with suggestions. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     Class API (modifiers are extra classes / attributes on the same element):
       .oc-tag: Chip
       .oc-tag-remove: Remove button inside a chip
       .oc-tag-input: Bordered container holding chips and one <input>
       .oc-tag-suggestions: Row of suggestion buttons below the control
     Optional script (below): Enter/comma adds, × removes, Backspace removes the last tag, suggestions add.
     data-name="tags[]" on .oc-tag-input gives every tag a hidden field, so a form submits the tags.
-->
<div class="oc-tag-input" data-name="tags[]">
  <span class="oc-tag">design <button class="oc-tag-remove" type="button" aria-label="Remove design">&times;</button></span>
  <span class="oc-tag">internal <button class="oc-tag-remove" type="button" aria-label="Remove internal">&times;</button></span>
  <input type="text" placeholder="Add tag..." aria-label="Add tag" list="oc-tag-options">
</div>
<div class="oc-tag-suggestions">
  <button type="button">customer</button>
  <button type="button">supplier</button>
  <button type="button">partner</button>
</div>
<script>
  // Tag input: Enter or comma adds a tag, × removes one, Backspace in the empty field removes the last one,
  // a suggestion button adds its text. With data-name="tags[]" on .oc-tag-input every tag carries a hidden field.
  (() => {
    const field = (box) => box.querySelector("input:not([type=hidden])");
    const tags = (box) => [...box.querySelectorAll(".oc-tag")];
    const label = (tag) => tag.firstChild.textContent.trim();
    const addTag = (box, text) => {
      const value = text.trim().replace(/,+$/, "");
      if (!value || tags(box).some((t) => label(t) === value)) return;
      const tag = document.createElement("span");
      tag.className = "oc-tag";
      tag.append(`${value} `);
      const remove = document.createElement("button");
      remove.type = "button";
      remove.className = "oc-tag-remove";
      remove.setAttribute("aria-label", `Remove ${value}`);
      remove.textContent = "×";
      tag.append(remove);
      if (box.dataset.name) {
        const hidden = document.createElement("input");
        hidden.type = "hidden"; hidden.name = box.dataset.name; hidden.value = value;
        tag.append(hidden);
      }
      box.insertBefore(tag, field(box));
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
      const box = e.target.closest?.(".oc-tag-input");
      if (!box || e.target !== field(box)) return;
      if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === ",") { e.preventDefault(); addTag(box, e.target.value); e.target.value = ""; }
      else if (e.key === "Backspace" && !e.target.value) tags(box).pop()?.remove();
    });
    document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      const remove = e.target.closest?.(".oc-tag-remove");
      if (remove) { const box = remove.closest(".oc-tag-input"); remove.closest(".oc-tag").remove(); field(box)?.focus(); return; }
      const suggestion = e.target.closest?.(".oc-tag-suggestions button");
      const box = suggestion?.closest(".oc-tag-suggestions").previousElementSibling;
      if (box?.matches(".oc-tag-input")) addTag(box, suggestion.textContent);
    });
  })();
</script>
```

### password-input

Password field with show/hide button

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: password-input - Password field with show/hide button. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     Class API (modifiers are extra classes / attributes on the same element):
       .oc-input-reveal: Wrapper (relative)
       .oc-input: The password input
       .oc-input-reveal-button: Toggle button (aria-pressed reflects the state)
-->
<div class="oc-field">
  <label class="oc-field-label" for="oc-password-demo">Password</label>
  <div class="oc-input-reveal">
    <input class="oc-input" id="oc-password-demo" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" value="secret-value">
    <button class="oc-input-reveal-button" type="button" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Toggle password visibility">Show</button>
  </div>
</div>
<script>
  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const btn = e.target.closest('.oc-input-reveal-button');
    if (!btn) return;
    const input = btn.parentElement.querySelector('input');
    const show = input.type === 'password';
    input.type = show ? 'text' : 'password';
    btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(show));
    btn.textContent = show ? 'Hide' : 'Show';
  });
</script>
```

### copy-field

Read-only monospace value with a copy button

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: copy-field - Read-only monospace value with a copy button. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     Class API (modifiers are extra classes / attributes on the same element):
       .oc-copy-field: Wrapper
       .oc-copy-field-value: Read-only <input readonly> (or <output>)
       .oc-copy-field-button: Copy button; add .is-copied for 2s feedback
-->
<div class="oc-copy-field">
  <input class="oc-copy-field-value" type="text" readonly value="JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP" aria-label="Setup key">
  <button class="oc-copy-field-button" type="button">Copy</button>
</div>
<script>
  document.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
    const btn = e.target.closest('.oc-copy-field-button');
    if (!btn) return;
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(btn.parentElement.querySelector('.oc-copy-field-value').value);
    btn.classList.add('is-copied');
    setTimeout(() => btn.classList.remove('is-copied'), 2000);
  });
</script>
```

### code-window

Code window with title bar and copy-to-clipboard button on the Code block

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: code-window - Window frame around code, with a copy button. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     Class API: .oc-code-window · .oc-code-window__bar (+ <i> dots) · .oc-code-window__title · .oc-code-window__body (plain code) or .oc-code-block (highlighted) ·
       .oc-code-copy (button; add .is-copied after copying). The one-line script below does the copy; everything else is CSS.
-->
<div class="oc-code-window">
  <div class="oc-code-window__bar">
    <i></i><i></i><i></i>
    <span class="oc-code-window__title">index.html</span>
    <button type="button" class="oc-code-copy" data-oc-copy="#oc-sample-code">Copy</button>
  </div>
  <pre class="oc-code-window__body"><code id="oc-sample-code">&lt;link rel="stylesheet" href="omnia.css"&gt;
&lt;button class="oc-btn"&gt;Hello&lt;/button&gt;</code></pre>
</div>
<script>
document.addEventListener("click", async (e) => {
  const b = e.target.closest("[data-oc-copy]"); if (!b) return;
  await navigator.clipboard.writeText(document.querySelector(b.dataset.ocCopy).textContent);
  b.classList.add("is-copied"); b.textContent = "Copied"; setTimeout(() => { b.classList.remove("is-copied"); b.textContent = "Copy"; }, 1500);
});
</script>
```

```html
  </div>
</div>

  <p>Short text that is always visible.</p>
  <p class="oc-showmore__extra">Extra text that appears after pressing the button.</p>
```

### toggle

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: toggle - Toggle and toggle group: pressed state on checkbox/radio or aria-pressed. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     Class API (modifiers are extra classes / attributes on the same element):
       .oc-toggle: label (around input) or button. On state: input:checked, [aria-pressed=true], [data-state=on]. Variants: --outline. Sizes: --sm, --lg. --icon: square
       .oc-toggle-group: connected toggles (radio inputs = single, checkbox inputs = multiple). Modifier: --spaced
-->
<div class="oc-toggle-group" role="group" aria-label="Text formatting">
  <label class="oc-toggle oc-toggle--outline oc-toggle--icon" title="Bold"><input type="checkbox" name="fmt" value="bold" aria-label="Bold" checked><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 4h8a4 4 0 0 1 0 8H6zM6 12h9a4 4 0 0 1 0 8H6z"/></svg></label>
  <label class="oc-toggle oc-toggle--outline oc-toggle--icon" title="Italic"><input type="checkbox" name="fmt" value="italic" aria-label="Italic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M19 4h-9M14 20H5M15 4 9 20"/></svg></label>
  <label class="oc-toggle oc-toggle--outline oc-toggle--icon" title="Underline"><input type="checkbox" name="fmt" value="underline" aria-label="Underline"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 4v6a6 6 0 0 0 12 0V4M4 21h16"/></svg></label>
```

### context-menu

Context menu: dropdown menu at the pointer with a minimal documented script

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: context-menu - Context menu: dropdown menu at the pointer with a minimal documented script. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     Class API (modifiers are extra classes / attributes on the same element):
       .oc-dropdown-menu.oc-context-menu[popover]: the menu (role="menu"); position from --oc-context-x / --oc-context-y
       .oc-context-area: dashed right-click target (demo styling)
       Script: contextmenu -> preventDefault, set the two variables, showPopover()
-->
<div class="oc-context-area" id="oc-ctx-area" tabindex="0">Right-click (or press the menu key) here</div>
<div class="oc-dropdown-menu oc-context-menu" id="oc-ctx-menu" popover role="menu" aria-label="Actions">
  <button class="oc-dropdown-item" type="button" role="menuitem">Back <span class="oc-dropdown-shortcut">Alt &larr;</span></button>
  <button class="oc-dropdown-item" type="button" role="menuitem">Reload <span class="oc-dropdown-shortcut">Ctrl R</span></button>
  <div class="oc-dropdown-separator" role="separator"></div>
  <button class="oc-dropdown-item" type="button" role="menuitemcheckbox" aria-checked="true">Show bookmarks</button>
  <button class="oc-dropdown-item oc-dropdown-item--destructive" type="button" role="menuitem">Delete</button>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  var area = document.getElementById('oc-ctx-area'), menu = document.getElementById('oc-ctx-menu');
  area.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    menu.style.setProperty('--oc-context-x', Math.min(e.clientX, innerWidth - 220) + 'px');
    menu.style.setProperty('--oc-context-y', Math.min(e.clientY, innerHeight - 220) + 'px');
    menu.showPopover();
  });
})();
</script>
```

```html
-->
```

### accordion-accent

Accordion variant: every item is a card with a colored accent edge; presets or semantic colors per item - no JavaScript

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: accordion-accent - Accordion variant: every item is a card with a colored accent edge; presets or semantic colors per item - no JavaScript. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     File: packages/ui/snippets/accordion-accent.html | Map: accordion (accent) -> item (default primary) -> item (preset color) -> item (semantic color)
     Class API (modifiers are extra classes / attributes on the same element):
       .oc-accordion.oc-accordion--accent: Separate item cards with a 3px colored start edge. Combine with --flush for edge-only cards.
       Colors: an .oc-accent--blue / cyan / green / orange / red / violet / yellow preset on the accordion or one item,
               or .oc-accordion-item--success / --warning / --danger (or .oc-accordion--success / --warning / --danger for all items).
       Custom property: --oc-accordion-accent (any Omnia color token)
       .oc-accordion-accent-meta: Small accent-colored label at the end of the trigger
     Slots: items (details.oc-accordion-item + summary.oc-accordion-trigger + .oc-accordion-content)
-->
<div class="oc-accordion oc-accordion--accent">
  <details class="oc-accordion-item" name="oc-accent-demo" open>
    <summary class="oc-accordion-trigger">Customer details <span class="oc-accordion-accent-meta">Complete</span></summary>
    <div class="oc-accordion-content">Ada Lovelace, Main street 12, Ghent.</div>
  </details>
  <details class="oc-accordion-item oc-accent--violet" name="oc-accent-demo">
    <summary class="oc-accordion-trigger">Materials <span class="oc-accordion-accent-meta">4 items</span></summary>
    <div class="oc-accordion-content">Oak worktop, two cabinets, a sink and the tap.</div>
  </details>
  <details class="oc-accordion-item oc-accordion-item--warning" name="oc-accent-demo">
    <summary class="oc-accordion-trigger">Planning <span class="oc-accordion-accent-meta">Needs a date</span></summary>
    <div class="oc-accordion-content">Pick a start date with the customer.</div>
  </details>
</div>
```

### affix-input

Input with an inline prefix or suffix symbol (currency, percent, email)

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: affix-input - Price, margin and email fields. The symbol sits in its own column. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     File: packages/ui/snippets/affix-input.html | Map: euro column -> percent column -> email column
     Class API (modifiers are extra classes / attributes on the same element):
       .oc-input-group--affix: Add to .oc-input-group. The frame is the wrapper; .oc-input-addon is a column with a divider.
       .oc-input-group--end: Optional. Right-aligns the value.
       .oc-input-group--error: Red frame (also via aria-invalid="true" or :user-invalid on the input)
       .oc-input-addon: The symbol column. Before the input = left (euro, percent, @). After the input = right.
     States: :focus-within (ring), :user-invalid (red), disabled input (dimmed)
-->

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>
<div class="oc-field">

  <div class="oc-input-group oc-input-group--affix">
    <span class="oc-input-addon" aria-hidden="true">@</span>
```

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: column-menu - Column visibility checklist in a popover; hides table columns with :has() - no JavaScript. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.

     Class API (modifiers are extra classes / attributes on the same element):
       .oc-column-menu-scope: Wrapper around menu + table. An unchecked [data-col="n"] hides column n (1-10) of the .oc-table inside.
       .oc-column-menu[popover]: Popover panel, opened with button[popovertarget]
       .oc-column-menu-title: Small heading
       form.oc-column-menu-list: The checkbox list (a form, so button type="reset" restores the defaults)

      </div>
    </form>
  </div>
  <div class="oc-table-wrap">
    <table class="oc-table">
      <thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>E-mail</th><th>City</th><th>Phone</th></tr></thead>

        <tr><td>Alan Turing</td><td>alan@example.com</td><td>Manchester</td><td>+44 161 496 0002</td></tr>
      </tbody>

</div>
```

### confirm-dialog

Alert dialog variant: icon ring, close button, typed confirmation and a discard action - no JavaScript

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: confirm-dialog - Alert dialog variant: icon ring, close button, typed confirmation and a discard action - no JavaScript. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     File: packages/ui/snippets/confirm-dialog.html | Map: trigger -> dialog -> content (close, icon ring, title, form: message, typed field, footer)
     Class API (modifiers are extra classes / attributes on the same element):
       dialog.oc-modal + .oc-modal-content.oc-alert-dialog.oc-alert-dialog--<type>: The alert dialog (types: success, error, warning, info, question)
       .oc-alert-dialog--confirm: Confirm variant on the content box (larger thin icon ring, wider box, wrapping footer)
       .oc-alert-dialog-close: X button in the top corner (command="close")
       form.oc-alert-dialog-form[method=dialog]: Wraps body + footer; the submit button closes the dialog with its value as returnValue
       .oc-alert-dialog-typed: Label + input with pattern="WORD" required; the browser blocks submit until it matches
       .oc-alert-dialog-confirm: The confirm (submit) button; looks disabled while the typed value is invalid
       .oc-alert-dialog-discard: Optional third action at the start of the footer ("Don't save")
     Slots: icon, title, message, typed field (optional), footer buttons (discard, cancel, confirm)
-->
<button class="oc-btn oc-btn--destructive" type="button" command="show-modal" commandfor="oc-confirm-dialog-demo">Delete project</button>

<dialog class="oc-modal" id="oc-confirm-dialog-demo" closedby="any" aria-labelledby="oc-confirm-dialog-title" aria-describedby="oc-confirm-dialog-text">
  <div class="oc-modal-content oc-alert-dialog oc-alert-dialog--error oc-alert-dialog--confirm">
    <button class="oc-alert-dialog-close" type="button" command="close" commandfor="oc-confirm-dialog-demo" aria-label="Close">&times;</button>
    <span class="oc-alert-dialog-icon" aria-hidden="true">&times;</span>
    <h2 class="oc-modal-title" id="oc-confirm-dialog-title">Delete "Kitchen renovation"?</h2>
    <form class="oc-alert-dialog-form" method="dialog">
      <div class="oc-modal-body" id="oc-confirm-dialog-text">This removes the project, its quotes and all files. This cannot be undone.</div>
      <label class="oc-alert-dialog-typed">
        <span>Type <code>DELETE</code> to confirm</span>
        <input class="oc-input" name="confirm" pattern="DELETE" required autocomplete="off">
      </label>
      <div class="oc-modal-footer">
        <button class="oc-btn oc-btn--outline" type="button" command="close" commandfor="oc-confirm-dialog-demo">Cancel</button>
        <button class="oc-btn oc-btn--destructive oc-alert-dialog-confirm" type="submit" value="confirm">Delete project</button>
      </div>
    </form>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: decimal-input - Text field for locale decimals like 1.234,56, with an optional unit. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     File: packages/ui/snippets/decimal-input.html | Map: plain field -> field with unit (wrapper + unit)
```

### image-zoom

Zoom and pan viewport with CSS-only zoom levels

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: image-zoom — Zoom and pan viewport with CSS-only zoom levels. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     File: packages/ui/snippets/image-zoom.html | Map: root -> toolbar (radio chips) -> viewport -> canvas (img)
     Class API: .oc-image-zoom > .oc-image-zoom__toolbar (.oc-image-zoom__label, label.oc-image-zoom__level > input[type=radio][value]) ·
       .oc-image-zoom__viewport (tabindex=0, scroll = pan) > .oc-image-zoom__canvas > img / svg / .oc-media-art.
     Zoom levels: radio values 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4 (picked up with :has()), or a fixed class .oc-image-zoom--150 / --200 / --300,
       or style="--oc-zoom: 2.5". Ratio: 16 / 9 default, .oc-image-zoom--square / --photo or --oc-image-zoom-ratio.
     Pan: scrollbars, mouse wheel (Shift = sideways), touch drag, or arrow keys on the focused viewport. No JavaScript.
-->
<div class="oc-image-zoom">
  <div class="oc-image-zoom__toolbar" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Zoom level">

    <label class="oc-image-zoom__level"><input type="radio" name="oc-zoom-demo" value="3">300%</label>
  </div>
  <div class="oc-image-zoom__viewport" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="Harbour map, scroll to pan">
    <div class="oc-image-zoom__canvas">
      <div class="oc-media-art oc-media-art--2">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 160 90" role="img" aria-label="Harbour map" style="display:block;inline-size:100%;block-size:100%;color:var(--color-white-50)">
          <path d="M0 15H160M0 30H160M0 45H160M0 60H160M0 75H160M20 0V90M40 0V90M60 0V90M80 0V90M100 0V90M120 0V90M140 0V90" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width=".3"/>
```

### lightbox

Image viewer on a native <dialog> with prev / next, counter and caption

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: lightbox — Image viewer on a native <dialog> with prev / next, counter and caption. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     File: packages/ui/snippets/lightbox.html | Map: thumbnails -> dialog (bar, track of slides) -> optional script
     Class API: .oc-lightbox-thumbs > button.oc-lightbox-thumb (command="show-modal" commandfor="<dialog id>") ·
       dialog.oc-lightbox > .oc-lightbox__bar (.oc-lightbox__title, button.oc-lightbox__close) ·
       .oc-lightbox__track (tabindex=0, autofocus) > figure.oc-lightbox__slide#id >
         .oc-lightbox__media (img) · a.oc-lightbox__nav--prev / --next (href="#<slide id>") · figcaption.oc-lightbox__caption (.oc-lightbox__counter).
     Modifiers: .oc-lightbox--single (hides nav + counter). Slots: any img / video / .oc-media-art in .oc-lightbox__media.
     No JavaScript needed: the thumbnails open the dialog, links jump between slides, Esc / backdrop close it.
     The optional script below only makes a thumbnail open the viewer at its own slide (data-oc-lightbox-slide).
-->
<div class="oc-lightbox-thumbs">
  <button type="button" class="oc-lightbox-thumb" command="show-modal" commandfor="oc-lightbox-demo" data-oc-lightbox-slide="oc-lightbox-demo-1" aria-label="Open photo 1: Harbour at dawn"><span class="oc-media-art"></span></button>
  <button type="button" class="oc-lightbox-thumb" command="show-modal" commandfor="oc-lightbox-demo" data-oc-lightbox-slide="oc-lightbox-demo-2" aria-label="Open photo 2: Forest trail"><span class="oc-media-art oc-media-art--4"></span></button>
  <button type="button" class="oc-lightbox-thumb" command="show-modal" commandfor="oc-lightbox-demo" data-oc-lightbox-slide="oc-lightbox-demo-3" aria-label="Open photo 3: Desert road"><span class="oc-media-art oc-media-art--6"></span></button>
</div>

<dialog class="oc-lightbox" id="oc-lightbox-demo" closedby="any" aria-label="Photo viewer">
  <div class="oc-lightbox__bar">
    <h2 class="oc-lightbox__title">Holiday photos</h2>
    <button type="button" class="oc-lightbox__close" command="close" commandfor="oc-lightbox-demo" aria-label="Close">&#10005;</button>
  </div>
  <div class="oc-lightbox__track" tabindex="0" autofocus aria-label="Photos, use the arrow keys">
    <figure class="oc-lightbox__slide" id="oc-lightbox-demo-1">
      <div class="oc-lightbox__media"><div class="oc-media-art" role="img" aria-label="Harbour at dawn"></div></div>
      <a class="oc-lightbox__nav oc-lightbox__nav--prev" href="#oc-lightbox-demo-3" aria-label="Previous photo">&#8592;</a>
      <a class="oc-lightbox__nav oc-lightbox__nav--next" href="#oc-lightbox-demo-2" aria-label="Next photo">&#8594;</a>
      <figcaption class="oc-lightbox__caption"><span class="oc-lightbox__counter">1 / 3</span> Harbour at dawn</figcaption>
    </figure>
    <figure class="oc-lightbox__slide" id="oc-lightbox-demo-2">
      <div class="oc-lightbox__media"><div class="oc-media-art oc-media-art--4" role="img" aria-label="Forest trail"></div></div>
      <a class="oc-lightbox__nav oc-lightbox__nav--prev" href="#oc-lightbox-demo-1" aria-label="Previous photo">&#8592;</a>
      <a class="oc-lightbox__nav oc-lightbox__nav--next" href="#oc-lightbox-demo-3" aria-label="Next photo">&#8594;</a>
      <figcaption class="oc-lightbox__caption"><span class="oc-lightbox__counter">2 / 3</span> Forest trail</figcaption>
    </figure>
    <figure class="oc-lightbox__slide" id="oc-lightbox-demo-3">
      <div class="oc-lightbox__media"><div class="oc-media-art oc-media-art--6" role="img" aria-label="Desert road"></div></div>
      <a class="oc-lightbox__nav oc-lightbox__nav--prev" href="#oc-lightbox-demo-2" aria-label="Previous photo">&#8592;</a>
      <a class="oc-lightbox__nav oc-lightbox__nav--next" href="#oc-lightbox-demo-1" aria-label="Next photo">&#8594;</a>
      <figcaption class="oc-lightbox__caption"><span class="oc-lightbox__counter">3 / 3</span> Desert road</figcaption>
    </figure>
  </div>
</dialog>
<script>
// Optional: open the viewer at the clicked thumbnail. The "command" event fires before the dialog opens,
// so the jump waits one frame. Without this script the viewer opens at the first (or last viewed) photo.
document.addEventListener("command", (e) => {
  const id = e.source?.dataset.ocLightboxSlide;
  if (id) requestAnimationFrame(() => document.getElementById(id)?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "instant", block: "nearest", inline: "center" }));
}, true);
// Optional: prev / next scroll without putting #slide in the address and the history (without this script they
// are plain links), and closing removes a slide hash of this viewer from the address.
document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  const nav = e.target.closest?.("dialog.oc-lightbox a.oc-lightbox__nav");
  const slide = nav && document.getElementById(decodeURIComponent(nav.hash.slice(1)));
  if (!slide) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  slide.scrollIntoView({ behavior: matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches ? "instant" : "smooth", block: "nearest", inline: "center" });
});
document.addEventListener("close", (e) => {
  const slide = e.target.matches?.("dialog.oc-lightbox") && location.hash && document.getElementById(decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1)));
  if (slide && e.target.contains(slide)) history.replaceState(history.state, "", location.pathname + location.search);
}, true);
</script>
```

### number-input

Number field with minus and plus step buttons

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: number-input - Number field with minus and plus step buttons. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     File: packages/ui/snippets/number-input.html | Map: wrapper -> minus button -> number field -> plus button -> optional script
     Class API (modifiers are extra classes / attributes on the same element):
       .oc-number-input: Frame around buttons and field. Modifiers: --sm, --block (full width), --error.
       .oc-number-input-step: Minus / plus button (data-oc-step="-1" or "1")
       .oc-number-input-field: input type="number" (min, max, step work natively; spinners hidden)
     States: :focus-within (ring), :user-invalid outside min/max (red), disabled field (dimmed)
     The field works without JavaScript (arrow keys). The script below makes the buttons call stepDown()/stepUp().
-->
<div class="oc-number-input">
  <button class="oc-number-input-step" type="button" data-oc-step="-1" aria-label="Decrease">&minus;</button>
  <input class="oc-number-input-field" type="number" name="quantity" value="2" min="0" max="99" step="1" aria-label="Quantity">
  <button class="oc-number-input-step" type="button" data-oc-step="1" aria-label="Increase">+</button>
</div>
<script>
  // One listener for every number input on the page. stepUp/stepDown respect min, max and step.
  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const btn = e.target.closest('.oc-number-input-step');
    if (!btn) return;
    const input = btn.parentElement.querySelector('.oc-number-input-field');
    if (!input || input.disabled) return;
    btn.dataset.ocStep === '-1' ? input.stepDown() : input.stepUp();
    // Let forms and frameworks know the value changed.
    input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
    input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
  });
</script>
```

### password-requirements

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: password-requirements - Live checklist of password rules under a password field. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.

  <input class="oc-input" id="oc-password-rules-demo" type="password" autocomplete="new-password" aria-describedby="oc-password-rules-demo-list" value="Secret1">
  <ul class="oc-password-requirements" id="oc-password-rules-demo-list" aria-live="polite" data-oc-password-for="oc-password-rules-demo">
    <li class="oc-password-requirement" data-min="8">At least 8 characters</li>
    <li class="oc-password-requirement oc-password-requirement--met" data-pattern="[A-Z]">One uppercase letter</li>
    <li class="oc-password-requirement oc-password-requirement--met" data-pattern="[0-9]">One number</li>
    <li class="oc-password-requirement" data-pattern="[^A-Za-z0-9]">One symbol</li>
  </ul>
</div>
<script>
  // Re-check every rule of a linked list when its password field changes.
  document.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
    const list = e.target.id && document.querySelector(`[data-oc-password-for="${e.target.id}"]`);
    if (!list) return;
    for (const rule of list.querySelectorAll('.oc-password-requirement')) {
      const value = e.target.value;
      const met = rule.dataset.min ? value.length >= Number(rule.dataset.min) : new RegExp(rule.dataset.pattern).test(value);
      rule.classList.toggle('oc-password-requirement--met', met);
    }
  });
</script>
```

```html
    <button type="button" class="oc-emoji-picker__item">&#128548;</button><button type="button" class="oc-emoji-picker__item">&#129303;</button>
  </div>
  <p class="oc-emoji-picker__label">Gestures</p>
  <div class="oc-emoji-picker__grid">
    <button type="button" class="oc-emoji-picker__item">&#128077;</button><button type="button" class="oc-emoji-picker__item">&#128078;</button>
    <button type="button" class="oc-emoji-picker__item">&#128079;</button><button type="button" class="oc-emoji-picker__item">&#128588;</button>
    <button type="button" class="oc-emoji-picker__item">&#128075;</button><button type="button" class="oc-emoji-picker__item">&#128591;</button>
    <button type="button" class="oc-emoji-picker__item">&#9996;&#65039;</button><button type="button" class="oc-emoji-picker__item">&#128170;</button>
  </div>
  <p class="oc-emoji-picker__label">Objects</p>
  <div class="oc-emoji-picker__grid">
    <button type="button" class="oc-emoji-picker__item">&#10084;&#65039;</button><button type="button" class="oc-emoji-picker__item">&#11088;</button>
    <button type="button" class="oc-emoji-picker__item">&#128293;</button><button type="button" class="oc-emoji-picker__item">&#127881;</button>
    <button type="button" class="oc-emoji-picker__item">&#9989;</button><button type="button" class="oc-emoji-picker__item">&#128640;</button>
    <button type="button" class="oc-emoji-picker__item">&#128161;</button><button type="button" class="oc-emoji-picker__item">&#9749;</button>
  </div>
</div>
<script>
// Optional: put the clicked emoji at the cursor of the field in data-oc-emoji-target, then close the picker.
document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  const item = e.target.closest(".oc-emoji-picker__item");
  const picker = item?.closest(".oc-emoji-picker");
  const field = picker?.dataset.ocEmojiTarget && document.querySelector(picker.dataset.ocEmojiTarget);
  if (!field) return;
  field.setRangeText(item.textContent, field.selectionStart ?? field.value.length, field.selectionEnd ?? field.value.length, "end");
  field.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  picker.hidePopover?.();
  field.focus();
});
</script>
```

### busy-overlay

Modal "please wait" overlay while a long form submit or upload runs

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: busy-overlay — Modal "please wait" overlay while a long form submit or upload runs. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     File: packages/ui/snippets/busy-overlay.html | Map: form[data-oc-busy] -> dialog (spinner or progress, title, text) -> script
     Class API (modifiers are extra classes / attributes on the same element):
       dialog.oc-busy-overlay[closedby="none"]: The overlay; modal, so the page is inert and Esc does not close it
       .oc-spinner (or .oc-progress > .oc-progress-bar for a known percentage): Activity
       .oc-busy-overlay__title / __text: What is happening and how long it may take
       form[data-oc-busy="<dialog id>"]: Opens the overlay when the form is submitted (after the browser's own validation)
     The overlay appears after 300ms, so quick requests never flash. The page that loads next replaces it;
     after a fetch() call close it yourself with dialog.close().
-->
<form class="oc-form-group" data-oc-busy="oc-busy-overlay-demo" action="/photos" method="post" enctype="multipart/form-data">
  <label class="oc-dropzone">
    <input type="file" name="photos[]" accept="image/*" multiple>
    <span><strong>Choose photos</strong> to upload</span>
    <span class="oc-dropzone-hint">They are resized to 600px and 1080px after saving</span>
  </label>
  <button class="oc-btn" type="submit">Save</button>
</form>

<dialog class="oc-busy-overlay" id="oc-busy-overlay-demo" closedby="none" aria-labelledby="oc-busy-overlay-demo-title" aria-describedby="oc-busy-overlay-demo-text">
  <span class="oc-spinner" role="status" aria-label="Busy"></span>
  <h2 class="oc-busy-overlay__title" id="oc-busy-overlay-demo-title">Saving…</h2>
  <p class="oc-busy-overlay__text" id="oc-busy-overlay-demo-text">The photos are being processed. This can take a minute; please keep this page open.</p>
</dialog>
<script>
// Open the busy overlay of a form when it is submitted (the submit event only fires when the form is valid).
document.addEventListener("submit", (e) => {
  const id = e.target.dataset?.ocBusy;
  if (id) document.getElementById(id)?.showModal();
});
</script>
```

### cookie-consent

Cookie banner with categories on popover="manual"; a small script remembers the choice

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: cookie-consent — Cookie banner with categories on popover="manual"; a small script remembers the choice. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     File: packages/ui/snippets/cookie-consent.html | Map: reopen link -> popover (title, text, details with category switches, actions) -> script
     Class API (modifiers are extra classes / attributes on the same element):
       aside.oc-cookie-consent[popover="manual"]: The banner (bottom-right card). Modifier: --bar (full-width bar at the bottom)
       .oc-cookie-consent__title / __text: Heading and text (put the policy link in the text)
       details.oc-cookie-consent__prefs: "Customize" with one .oc-cookie-consent__category per purpose
       .oc-cookie-consent__category > __category-name, __category-text, label.oc-switch (input name = category; necessary: checked disabled)
       .oc-cookie-consent__actions > button[data-oc-consent="necessary" | "selected" | "all"]
       [data-oc-consent-open]: Any button or link that opens the banner again (footer "Cookie settings")
       [data-oc-consent-manual] on the banner: never open by itself (only through data-oc-consent-open)
     Script: shows the banner when no choice is stored, saves { necessary, statistics, marketing, date } in localStorage
       under "oc-consent" and fires a "oc-consent" event on document with that object as detail. Load your analytics there.
-->
<button type="button" class="oc-btn oc-btn--outline oc-btn--sm" data-oc-consent-open>Cookie settings</button>

<aside class="oc-cookie-consent" id="oc-cookie-consent" popover="manual" aria-labelledby="oc-cookie-consent-title">
  <h2 class="oc-cookie-consent__title" id="oc-cookie-consent-title"><span aria-hidden="true">&#127850;</span> We use cookies</h2>
  <p class="oc-cookie-consent__text">Necessary cookies keep the site working. With your permission we also measure visits to improve the site. Read the <a href="#cookie-policy">cookie policy</a>.</p>
  <details class="oc-cookie-consent__prefs">
    <summary>Customize</summary>
    <div class="oc-cookie-consent__category">
      <span class="oc-cookie-consent__category-name">Necessary</span>
      <span class="oc-cookie-consent__category-text">Session, security and your cookie choice. Always on.</span>
      <label class="oc-switch"><input type="checkbox" role="switch" name="necessary" checked disabled aria-label="Necessary cookies"><span class="oc-switch-track"></span></label>
    </div>
    <div class="oc-cookie-consent__category">
      <span class="oc-cookie-consent__category-name">Statistics</span>
      <span class="oc-cookie-consent__category-text">Anonymous visit counts.</span>
      <label class="oc-switch"><input type="checkbox" role="switch" name="statistics" aria-label="Statistics cookies"><span class="oc-switch-track"></span></label>
    </div>
    <div class="oc-cookie-consent__category">
      <span class="oc-cookie-consent__category-name">Marketing</span>
      <span class="oc-cookie-consent__category-text">Embedded videos and ads that track you.</span>
      <label class="oc-switch"><input type="checkbox" role="switch" name="marketing" aria-label="Marketing cookies"><span class="oc-switch-track"></span></label>
    </div>
  </details>
  <div class="oc-cookie-consent__actions">
    <button type="button" class="oc-btn oc-btn--outline" data-oc-consent="necessary">Only necessary</button>
    <button type="button" class="oc-btn oc-btn--secondary" data-oc-consent="selected">Save choice</button>
    <button type="button" class="oc-btn" data-oc-consent="all">Accept all</button>
  </div>
</aside>
<script>
// Cookie consent: show when no choice is stored, save the choice, tell the page (event "oc-consent").
(() => {
  const box = document.getElementById("oc-cookie-consent");
  if (!box) return;
  const KEY = "oc-consent";
  const read = () => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)); } catch { return null; } };
  const inputs = () => [...box.querySelectorAll("input[name]")];
  const apply = (choice) => { for (const i of inputs()) if (!i.disabled) i.checked = !!choice?.[i.name]; };
  const stored = read();
  if (stored) document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("oc-consent", { detail: stored }));
  else if (!box.hasAttribute("data-oc-consent-manual")) box.showPopover();
  box.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    const mode = e.target.closest("[data-oc-consent]")?.dataset.ocConsent;
    if (!mode) return;
    const choice = { necessary: true, date: new Date().toISOString() };
    for (const i of inputs()) if (!i.disabled) choice[i.name] = mode === "all" || (mode === "selected" && i.checked);
    try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(choice)); } catch {}
    box.hidePopover();
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("oc-consent", { detail: choice }));
  });
  document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    if (!e.target.closest("[data-oc-consent-open]")) return;
    apply(read());
    box.showPopover();
  });
})();
</script>
```

### doc-viewer

PDF, video or image in a card with a label and a full-screen view on a native <dialog>

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: doc-viewer — PDF, video or image in a card with a label and a full-screen view on a native <dialog>. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     File: packages/ui/snippets/doc-viewer.html | Map: grid -> card (bar: label + expand button, frame) -> full-screen dialog
     Class API (modifiers are extra classes / attributes on the same element):
       .oc-doc-viewer-grid: Optional grid of viewers (auto-fill, min 15rem)
       figure.oc-doc-viewer: One card. Modifiers: --video (16/9, dark), --image (natural height). Default frame is A4 (PDF).
       .oc-doc-viewer__bar > .oc-doc-viewer__label, .oc-doc-viewer__meta, button.oc-doc-viewer__expand (command="show-modal" commandfor="<dialog id>")
       .oc-doc-viewer__frame > iframe | video | img | object: The inline preview
       button.oc-doc-viewer__open: Optional, inside the frame: the whole preview opens the dialog ("Click for full screen")

     PDF: <iframe src="file.pdf#toolbar=0&view=FitH" title="…" loading="lazy">. Video: <video src="…" controls preload="metadata">.
```

### message-thread

Scrolling conversation: header with subject, people, status and actions menu, messages that start at the bottom, composer and a sending overlay

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: message-thread — Scrolling conversation: header with subject, people, status and actions menu, messages that start at the bottom, composer and a sending overlay. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     File: packages/ui/snippets/message-thread.html | Map: thread -> header (heading, people, badge, menu) -> scroll (message list) -> footer (attachments + chat-composer) -> busy overlay -> optional script
     Class API (modifiers are extra classes / attributes on the same element):
       section.oc-message-thread: Grid frame, height from --oc-message-thread-height (32rem). Modifier: --plain (no wallpaper).
         State: aria-busy="true" shows the sending overlay
       .oc-message-thread__header > .oc-message-thread__heading (__title, __meta), .oc-avatar-group.oc-message-thread__people,
         .oc-message-thread__actions > .oc-badge, button.oc-message-thread__icon-btn (popovertarget) + .oc-dropdown-menu[popover]
       .oc-message-thread__scroll (tabindex="0", role="log"): Scroll area; column-reverse, so it opens at the newest message.
         Holds one .oc-message-list (message component)
       .oc-message-thread__footer: Bottom bar with an optional .oc-attachment-list and the chat-composer, or a .oc-message-thread__note
       .oc-message-thread__busy (role="status"): Overlay with .oc-spinner, strong and span
     Optional script (end of this snippet): appends what you type as an outgoing message after a short "Sending" state and
       sends with Ctrl/Cmd + Enter. In an app, post the form and render the new message on the server instead.
-->
<section class="oc-message-thread" aria-labelledby="oc-thread-demo-title" style="inline-size:100%;max-inline-size:40rem">
  <header class="oc-message-thread__header">

          <p class="oc-message__meta"><time datetime="2026-10-14T09:20">09:20</time><span class="oc-message__status oc-message__status--read">Read</span></p>
        </div>
        <div class="oc-message__actions"><button type="button" class="oc-message__action oc-message__action--destructive" aria-label="Delete this message"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 6h18M8 6V4h8v2M19 6l-1 14H6L5 6M10 11v6M14 11v6"/></svg></button></div>
      </article>
      <div class="oc-message-divider"><span>Today</span></div>
      <article class="oc-message">
        <span class="oc-avatar oc-message__avatar">LV</span>
        <div class="oc-message__bubble">
          <p class="oc-message__sender">Lisa Verbeke</p>
          <div class="oc-message__text"><p>Client signed. Can you confirm the edge profile before 16:00?</p></div>
          <p class="oc-message__meta"><time datetime="2026-10-24T10:02">10:02</time></p>
        </div>
      </article>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="oc-message-thread__footer">
    <form class="oc-chat-composer" action="#" aria-label="Reply">
      <label class="oc-visually-hidden" for="oc-thread-demo-input">Message</label>
      <textarea class="oc-chat-composer__input" id="oc-thread-demo-input" name="message" rows="1" placeholder="Type your reply…" required></textarea>
      <div class="oc-chat-composer__bar">
        <div class="oc-chat-composer__tools">
          <button type="button" class="oc-chat-composer__tool" aria-label="Attach a file">&#128206;</button>
          <button type="button" class="oc-chat-composer__tool" aria-label="Insert emoji">&#128578;</button>
        </div>
        <span class="oc-chat-composer__hint">Ctrl + Enter to send</span>
        <button type="submit" class="oc-chat-composer__send" aria-label="Send">&#10148;</button>
      </div>
    </form>
  </div>

  <div class="oc-message-thread__busy" role="status">
    <span class="oc-spinner oc-spinner--lg" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    <strong>Sending message…</strong>
    <span>Please wait, do not close this conversation.</span>
  </div>
</section>
<script>
// Optional: append the typed message as an outgoing bubble (demo behaviour; an app posts the form instead).
document.addEventListener("submit", (e) => {
  const form = e.target.closest(".oc-message-thread form.oc-chat-composer");
  if (!form || e.defaultPrevented) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  const thread = form.closest(".oc-message-thread"), field = form.querySelector("textarea"), text = field.value.trim();
  if (!text) return;
  thread.setAttribute("aria-busy", "true");
  setTimeout(() => {
    const list = thread.querySelector(".oc-message-list"), last = list.lastElementChild;
    const msg = document.createElement("article");
    msg.className = "oc-message oc-message--out" + (last?.matches(".oc-message--out") ? " oc-message--continued" : "");
    msg.innerHTML = '<span class="oc-avatar oc-message__avatar"></span><div class="oc-message__bubble"><div class="oc-message__text"><p></p></div><p class="oc-message__meta"><time></time><span class="oc-message__status">Sent</span></p></div>';
    msg.querySelector(".oc-avatar").textContent = list.querySelector(".oc-message--out .oc-avatar")?.textContent || "Me";
    msg.querySelector("p").textContent = text;
    msg.querySelector("time").textContent = new Date().toTimeString().slice(0, 5);
    list.append(msg);
    field.value = "";
    thread.removeAttribute("aria-busy");
    field.focus();
  }, 600);
});
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.defaultPrevented || e.key !== "Enter" || !(e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) || !e.target.matches(".oc-message-thread .oc-chat-composer__input")) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  e.target.form.requestSubmit();
});
</script>
```

### message

Chat bubble: incoming and outgoing, sender, avatar, time, read receipt, hover actions, grouping, reply quote and date divider

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: message — Chat bubble: incoming and outgoing, sender, avatar, time, read receipt, hover actions, grouping, reply quote and date divider. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     File: packages/ui/snippets/message.html | Map: list -> date divider -> incoming group (2) -> outgoing with quote + receipt -> system line
     Class API (modifiers are extra classes / attributes on the same element):
       .oc-message-list: Column of messages and dividers (role="log" when it updates live). Custom properties: --oc-message-in, --oc-message-out
       article.oc-message: One row. Modifiers: --out (right, primary tint), --continued (follows a message of the same sender:
         no name, the avatar moves to the last message of the group via :has())
       .oc-avatar.oc-message__avatar: Avatar (avatar component); keep it on every message so the grouping can hide it
       .oc-message__bubble > .oc-message__sender, a.oc-message__quote (strong + span), .oc-message__text (p, ul, ol, a, strong, code),
         .oc-message__attachments (attachment component), .oc-message__meta > time + .oc-message__status (--read, --failed)
       .oc-message__actions > button.oc-message__action (--destructive): Shown on hover and keyboard focus, always on touch screens
       .oc-message-divider > span: Date divider. Modifier: --system (a centred notice without lines)
     No JavaScript. Escape user text on the server; the markup only expects paragraphs, lists and links.
-->
<div class="oc-message-list" role="log" aria-label="Conversation with Lisa Verbeke" style="max-inline-size:36rem">
  <div class="oc-message-divider"><span>Tuesday 14 October</span></div>

  <article class="oc-message" aria-label="Lisa Verbeke, 09:12">

      <p class="oc-message__meta"><time datetime="2026-10-14T09:12">09:12</time></p>
    </div>
  </article>
  <article class="oc-message oc-message--continued" id="oc-message-demo-question" aria-label="Lisa Verbeke, 09:13">

    <div class="oc-message__bubble">
```

### prose

Typography for long-form CMS, blog and help text: headings, lists, quotes, code, tables, figures

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: prose — Typography for long-form CMS, blog and help text: headings, lists, quotes, code, tables, figures. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     File: packages/ui/snippets/prose.html | Map: article -> lead -> h2 + list -> figure -> h3 + ordered list -> blockquote -> table -> code -> hr + small print
     Class API (modifiers are extra classes / attributes on the same element):
       .oc-prose: Wrapper around HTML without classes (h1–h4, p, a, strong, em, mark, code, kbd, ul, ol, dl, blockquote,
         pre, table, figure, img, figcaption, hr). Width is 68ch. Modifiers: --sm, --lg (all spacing scales along), --full (no max width)
       .oc-prose-lead: Larger intro paragraph
     Rules use :where(), so they carry no extra weight: a utility class on an element inside the text still wins. No JavaScript.
-->
<article class="oc-prose">
  <h1>Planning a kitchen renovation</h1>
  <p class="oc-prose-lead">A new kitchen takes eight to twelve weeks from the first visit to the last cabinet handle. This guide explains every step, so you know what to expect and when we need you.</p>
  <h2>Before the first visit</h2>
  <p>Collect a few photos of kitchens you like and measure the room roughly. Exact measurements are not needed yet: our site manager does that during the visit. Read the <a href="#checklist">preparation checklist</a> if you want to be fully ready.</p>
  <ul>
    <li>The <strong>budget range</strong> you have in mind, including appliances</li>
    <li>Which walls, doors and windows can move, and which cannot
      <ul><li>Load-bearing walls need a structural engineer</li><li>Moving a window needs a permit in most towns</li></ul>
    </li>
    <li>Appliances you want to keep</li>
  </ul>
  <figure>
    <div class="oc-media-art oc-media-art--6" role="img" aria-label="Kitchen with oak fronts and a light stone worktop"></div>
    <figcaption>Villa Dewitte: oak fronts with a Calacatta matt worktop, finished in October 2026.</figcaption>
  </figure>
  <h3>From design to installation</h3>
  <ol>
    <li>Site visit and measurements (week 1)</li>
    <li>Design and quote, with two revision rounds (weeks 2–3)</li>
    <li>Order and production of the cabinets (weeks 4–9)</li>
    <li>Installation, worktop and finishing (weeks 10–11)</li>
  </ol>
  <blockquote>
    <p>The planning was clear from day one. We always knew who was coming and when, and the kitchen was ready a week early.</p>
    <footer>— Ann Dewitte, client in Ghent</footer>
  </blockquote>
  <h2>Worktop materials compared</h2>
  <table>
    <caption>Prices per running metre, 60 cm deep, installed.</caption>
    <thead><tr><th>Material</th><th>Thickness</th><th>Heat resistant</th><th>Price</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td>Compact laminate</td><td>12 mm</td><td>Up to 180 °C</td><td>€ 290</td></tr>
      <tr><td>Quartz composite</td><td>20 mm</td><td>Up to 150 °C</td><td>€ 540</td></tr>
      <tr><td>Natural stone</td><td>20 mm</td><td>Yes</td><td>€ 720</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  <h3>Sharing your floor plan</h3>
  <p>Upload a PDF or a photo in the client portal, or send it by e-mail. Press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>V</kbd> in the chat to paste a screenshot. Files are stored as <code>project-id/plans/</code> and only your project team can see them.</p>
  <pre><code>Project:   2026-114 Villa Dewitte
Room:      Kitchen, ground floor
Wall A:    412 cm (window at 160 cm)
Wall B:    298 cm (door at the left)</code></pre>
  <hr>
  <p><small>Lead times are an estimate. <mark>Natural stone</mark> can take two weeks longer in summer.</small></p>
</article>
```

### carousel-loop

Looping carousel: after the last slide the next button goes back to the first

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: carousel-loop - Looping carousel: after the last slide the next button goes back to the first. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS and @birdycom/omniaui/carousel.js.
     Class API: .oc-carousel--loop on the carousel, with .oc-carousel-prev / .oc-carousel-next buttons.
     Script: import { initCarousels } from "@birdycom/omniaui/carousel.js"; initCarousels();
     Without the script the buttons stay hidden and the CSS arrows (which stop at the ends) remain. -->
<div class="oc-carousel oc-carousel--loop">
  <div class="oc-carousel-viewport" id="loop-carousel" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-roledescription="carousel" aria-label="Highlights">

    <div class="oc-carousel-item" id="loop-slide-2" role="group" aria-roledescription="slide" aria-label="2 of 4">Slide 2</div>
    <div class="oc-carousel-item" id="loop-slide-3" role="group" aria-roledescription="slide" aria-label="3 of 4">Slide 3</div>

  </div>

  <button class="oc-carousel-next" type="button" aria-controls="loop-carousel" aria-label="Next slide">&rarr;</button>
  <nav class="oc-carousel-dots" aria-label="Choose a slide">
    <a class="oc-carousel-dot" href="#loop-slide-1" aria-label="Slide 1"></a>
    <a class="oc-carousel-dot" href="#loop-slide-2" aria-label="Slide 2"></a>
    <a class="oc-carousel-dot" href="#loop-slide-3" aria-label="Slide 3"></a>
    <a class="oc-carousel-dot" href="#loop-slide-4" aria-label="Slide 4"></a>
  </nav>
</div>
```
