### live-frame

A live page at a virtual size such as 1280x720, scaled down to the frame width without JavaScript

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: live-frame - A live page at a virtual size such as 1280x720, scaled down to the frame width without JavaScript. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     File: packages/ui/snippets/live-frame.html | Map: browser frame with a live view -> a live frame on its own (static, other size)
     Class API (modifiers are extra classes on the same element):
       .oc-live-frame: box with the ratio of the virtual size; its iframe / video / img / .oc-live-frame__content is laid out
         at that size and scaled to the box width (pure CSS: tan(atan2(100cqi, width)))
       Modifiers: --static (clicks and scrolling pass through: a picture of a page)
       Tokens: --oc-live-w, --oc-live-h (unitless px, default 1280 x 720)
       Also on .oc-browser-frame__view, the view slot of the browser frame.
     Slots: the iframe (or other content). Give the iframe a title; scrolling="no" hides its scrollbar.
-->
<div class="oc-browser-frame">

  <div class="oc-browser-frame__view oc-live-frame">
    <iframe src="https://omniaui.eu/" title="OmniaUI home page" loading="lazy" scrolling="no"></iframe>
  </div>
</div>

</div>
```

### titlebar

Draggable title bar for a frameless desktop window or widget, with a hairline once the body scrolls

```html
<!-- OmniaUI component: titlebar - Draggable title bar for a frameless desktop window or widget, with a hairline once the body scrolls. Needs @birdycom/omniaui CSS.
     File: packages/ui/snippets/titlebar.html | Map: div.oc-titlebar-window -> header.oc-titlebar (main: icon, title, subtitle | actions: buttons) -> div.oc-titlebar-body

       .oc-titlebar-window: column that shares the scroll timeline between bar and body
       .oc-titlebar: the bar; app-region: drag (Electron, Tauri move the window by it), buttons and fields stay clickable
       .oc-titlebar__main / __icon / __title / __subtitle (· before it, cuts off with …) / __actions
       .oc-titlebar__btn: compact icon button; --close turns red on hover
       .oc-titlebar-body: the part that scrolls; the bar gets a hairline once it scrolls (scroll-driven, no JavaScript)
       Modifiers: --bordered (hairline always), --sm
     Icon buttons need an aria-label. Inside a .oc-glass sheet the bar uses the glass hairline and surfaces.

      <button type="button" class="oc-titlebar__btn" aria-label="Settings"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M19.4 15a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 .3 1.8l.1.1a2 2 0 1 1-2.8 2.8l-.1-.1a1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1.8-.3 1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1 1.5V21a2 2 0 1 1-4 0v-.1a1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1.1-1.5 1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1.8.3l-.1.1a2 2 0 1 1-2.8-2.8l.1-.1a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 .3-1.8 1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1.5-1H3a2 2 0 1 1 0-4h.1a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1.5-1.1 1.7 1.7 0 0 0-.3-1.8l-.1-.1a2 2 0 1 1 2.8-2.8l.1.1a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1.8.3H9a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1-1.5V3a2 2 0 1 1 4 0v.1a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1 1.5 1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1.8-.3l.1-.1a2 2 0 1 1 2.8 2.8l-.1.1a1.7 1.7 0 0 0-.3 1.8V9a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1.5 1H21a2 2 0 1 1 0 4h-.1a1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1.5 1Z"/></svg></button>

    </div>
```

## Blocks

- [CMS dashboard (Pro)](https://omniaui.eu/ui/blocks/cms-dashboard): CMS admin home: dark sidebar with sections, top bar with page title and user, flash message, content tiles and recent changes
- [Pricing Block](https://omniaui.eu/ui/blocks/pricing): Pricing cards with a featured plan
- [About with timeline](https://omniaui.eu/ui/blocks/about-timeline): About section: picture with a badge next to the company story and a year timeline
- [App header](https://omniaui.eu/ui/blocks/app-header): Top bar with sidebar toggle, module navigation and user actions
- [App shell](https://omniaui.eu/ui/blocks/app-shell): Application layout: sidebar, header bar, breadcrumb strip and scrolling content
- [Auth split](https://omniaui.eu/ui/blocks/auth-split): Sign-in with a brand panel (logo, quote) next to the form
- [Authentication Block](https://omniaui.eu/ui/blocks/auth): Sign-in card
- [Calendars](https://omniaui.eu/ui/blocks/calendars)
- [Call to Action Block](https://omniaui.eu/ui/blocks/cta): Call to action banner
- [Charts gallery (Pro)](https://omniaui.eu/ui/blocks/charts): Charts gallery. Nine chart cards in pure CSS and SVG: bar, line (one and two series), area, stacked area, donut, radial, horizontal bars and a sparkline.

## Pro blocks (license)

- calendar-01: Calendar 01: Single month. Card with one month and a selected day.
- calendar-02: Calendar 02: Two months with a range. Two adjacent months with a selected date range and a summary line.
- calendar-03: Calendar 03: Date and time slots. Booking layout: a month on the left, a list of time slots for the selected day on the right.
- calendar-04: Calendar 04: Presets. Calendar with quick presets (today, tomorrow, next week) as buttons below.
- calendar-05: Calendar 05: Date picker in a form. Form with a date-picker field (button trigger plus a calendar popover) and a native time input.
- charts: Charts gallery. Nine chart cards in pure CSS and SVG: bar, line (one and two series), area, stacked area, donut, radial, horizontal bars and a sparkline.
- dashboard-01: Dashboard 01: Sidebar, KPIs, chart and data table. Complete dashboard page: app shell with sidebar, KPI cards, an area chart card and a data table.
- dashboard-stats: KPI cards with label, value, trend and note
- hub-launcher: Grid of launcher cards for modules or settings sections
- login-04: Login 04: Form with image on the right. Reversed split layout: form on the left, image panel on the right, three social buttons.
- login-05: Login 05: Magic link, minimal. No card and no password: one e-mail field that sends a sign-in link, with a social fallback.
- onboarding-checklist: Setup card with progress and a checklist of actions
- otp-03: OTP 03: Four digits with back link. Four-digit PIN on a muted page, with a back link and a resend hint.
- settings-page: Section navigation next to stacked settings sections with rows and a danger zone
- sidebar-06: Sidebar 06: User footer with dropdown menu. The footer user opens an account menu (popover, no JavaScript).
- sidebar-07: Sidebar 07: Collapsible to icons. A checkbox and :has() collapse the sidebar to an icon rail. Click the panel icon in the bar.
- sidebar-08: Sidebar 08: Inset with secondary navigation. The page sits in a rounded inset card; the sidebar blends into the page background and carries a secondary nav.
- sidebar-09: Sidebar 09: Double sidebar (rail and panel). An icon rail selects the section; the second sidebar lists that section.
- sidebar-10: Sidebar 10: Team switcher header. A header button opens a popover menu to switch between workspaces.
- sidebar-11: Sidebar 11: File tree. Nested folders from details elements, using the submenu guide lines as tree lines.
- sidebar-12: Sidebar 12: Calendar sidebar. A date calendar and a calendar list inside the sidebar, for planner and agenda apps.
- sidebar-13: Sidebar 13: Sidebar in a dialog. A settings dialog with a sidebar for its sections; opens with invoker commands, no JavaScript.
- sidebar-14: Sidebar 14: Right sidebar. The sidebar sits on the right edge (oc-sidebar--right).
- sidebar-15: Sidebar 15: Left and right sidebars. Navigation on the left, an inspector panel on the right.
- sidebar-16: Sidebar 16: Sticky header. The bar stays pinned while the page content scrolls underneath.
- signup-03: Signup 03: Muted background with social buttons. Sign-up card on a muted page: social buttons, divider, e-mail form and legal line.
- status-page: Split 404 / 403 / 500 page: big status code panel next to a card with title, text, detail and actions
- watch-layout: Video page: 16:9 player column with title, channel and description, plus an "Up next" list
- form-builder: Admin form builder: field cards you can reorder, a palette of field types and a dialog per field
- masonry-gallery: Project gallery: masonry grid with captions, a CSS-only category filter and the lightbox
- media-manager: Admin media manager: documents, videos and photos of one item with upload, reorder, select and delete
- services-tabs: Services section: one tab per service with a hero image or video, text, key points and documents (no JavaScript)
- cms-dashboard: CMS admin home: dark sidebar with sections, top bar with page title and user, flash message, content tiles and recent changes
- chat-inbox: Split chat inbox: searchable conversation list with unread dots and the selected message thread with a composer
- infinite-carousel: Infinite carousel: after the last slide the first one slides in from the right, no rewind
- pricing-plans: License pricing as on omniaui.eu: launch offer, plans with a yearly/lifetime switch per card, a featured plan, VAT note and checkout help
- spotlight-cards: Spotlight cards: product cards whose glow and border light follow the mouse
